<section>
  <div class="hero">
    <div class="intro">
      <h1>AI for a Sustainable Future</h1>
      <p class="sub">Sustainability Lab · IIT Gandhinagar</p>
      <p>We build AI that serves both people and the planet — from air quality and health sensing to energy and Earth observation.</p>
      <p>The lab is led by <a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Nipun Batra</a>. Our alumni have gone on to Cambridge, Microsoft Research, Google DeepMind, CMU and industry.</p>
      <p class="awards-line">Recent recognition: <b>Best Paper Runner-Up at BuildSys 2026</b>, the <b>ACM e-Energy Test-of-Time Award 2025</b> for NILMTK, and the <b>ACM SIGEnergy Rising Star 2025</b>. Work published at NeurIPS, KDD, AAAI, IMWUT, BuildSys and UbiComp.</p>
      <a class="recruit" href="join.html">Now recruiting PhD students &amp; interns</a>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="join.html">Join the lab</a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="flyer.pdf">Lab flyer (PDF)</a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="papers/index.html">Publications</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="film">
      <button class="film-open" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="film-dialog">
        <img src="images/film/poster.jpg" width="1600" height="900" alt="Still from the lab film: 30,638 brick kilns found from space across the Indo-Gangetic Plain">
        <span class="film-cta"><span class="film-play" aria-hidden="true"></span><span><b>Watch the lab film</b><span>2½ minutes · sound on</span></span></span>
      </button>
      <figcaption>Our research, people and alumni in one short film · <a href="people.html">meet everyone</a></figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
  <dialog id="film-dialog" class="film-dialog" aria-label="The Sustainability Lab film">
    <form method="dialog"><button class="film-close" aria-label="Close the film">Close ×</button></form>
    <video controls playsinline preload="none" poster="images/film/poster.jpg">
      <source src="images/film/lab-film.mp4" type="video/mp4">
    </video>
  </dialog>
  <script>
    (() => {
      const dialog = document.getElementById("film-dialog");
      const video = dialog.querySelector("video");
      document.querySelector(".film-open").addEventListener("click", () => {
        dialog.showModal();
        video.play().catch(() => {});
      });
      dialog.addEventListener("close", () => video.pause());
      dialog.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === dialog) dialog.close(); });
    })();
  </script>
</section>
